title: 10 Best Morus Alba Preparations
intro: The best medicinal preparations of Morus alba are teas, decoctions, tinctures, mucillages, and poultices, each offering unique therapeutic benefits. Teas made from the leaves or bark are commonly used to soothe digestive issues and reduce inflammation. Decoctions involve boiling the bark to extract its medicinal compounds, often used for respiratory and skin conditions. Tinctures provide a concentrated form of the herb, useful for internal and external applications. Mucillages, derived from the bark, are valued for their soothing properties, particularly in treating wounds and inflammation. Poultices made from fresh leaves or crushed bark are applied topically to reduce swelling and promote healing.
